event_detail: The gripper circles the toaster for the whole 40.0-44.8 s window. It hovers in front of the right-hand lever (the one for the empty slots), never pressing it, then moves over the top to the bread at 44.8 s without grasping it.
evidence: Wrist views at 40.0-43.2 s show the toaster front close up, with both lever blocks at the slot end of their tracks (not pushed down). In the shoulder views both levers stay up and the bread stays standing in the left slot in every frame. At 44.8 s the bread is just beyond the closed finger tips but has not been taken. I cannot see whether the lever was cycled earlier in the episode, so stage 1 is marked not done with low certainty.
